cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a desert oasis at golden hour — holds a water bottle at chest height; a harbour quay of a port town with tall sailing ships — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a Three Kingdoms festival street — lying on her side; a Roman marble bath hall — standing; a festival street of lanterns — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a small shop — trims the stems of a few loose flower stems on the worktable; a narrow city alley with hanging signboards and wet pavement — sitting on the ground; a space-station docking bay with a sleek shuttle on its pad and long light strips — standing; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — standing; inside a knightly order's campaign pavilion — sets a cup down on the surface in front of her; a Roman marble bath hall — plays a guzheng zither laid across her lap or a low table; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a penthouse window wall over the city at night — standing
